name: No Parliament
description: The only reason to summon others in front of the ruler can be to give orders, not to discuss policy.

name: Assembly
description: Summoning all free people of our domain is the only way for us to determine the focus of our country.

name: Council
description: While power is concentrated in a single authoritative monarch in many societies, many others have seen the alternative benefits of a system allowing a council to discuss and debate matters before acting upon them.

name: Estate Parliament
description: Representatives of the Estates will gather in the parliament to discuss issues and find common ground in achieving these goals.

name: Dutch Parliament
description: The wealthy members of parliament are granted greater powers, while the clergy is bared from having representatives.

name: Polish-Lithuanian Parliament
description: The parliament of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth grants greater powers to the noble representatives.

name: Autocratic Parliament
description: The issue with separated power is that many urgent actions from the government can easily be locked in bureaucratic chaos and dragging discussions. The power of the State must be focused on the hands of the sovereign to ensure the success of our country.

name: Constitutional Parliament
description: The authority of the ruler must be regulated while power and justice are in the hands of the people. In the Constitutional System, the role of the masses is significantly expanded.

name: Royal Assembly
description: The $union_royal_assembly$ is a rather rudimentary council for the entire [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName]. The [estates|e] of the members are summoned in the assembly to discuss and negotiate the implementation of centralizing [laws|e].

name: Court Assembly
description:
From the old days of [GetCharacter('ogk_otto_liudolfinger').GetName], the $hre_court_assembly$ is an ancient and primitive style of assembly within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. Due to the lack of codified processes, discussing law implementations with the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetLeaderTitle] tend to be not as efficient as they could be.

$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Greatly increases voting power for the [ShowSpecialStatusName('emperor')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')]
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Significantly reduces [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prelate')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('primas_germaniae')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('legatus_natus')] influence
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_peasant_republic')] have standard power

name: Early Imperial Diet
description:
The earliest form of [ShowLawName('imperial_diet_law')] represents the traditional order of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('hre').GetName]. Only the [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prince')] may participate, excluding [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')] and lower ecclesiastical entities from the legislative process.

$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Strong voting power for the [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('emperor')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prince')]
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')] and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_peasant_republic')] have no voting power
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Minor ecclesiastical roles like [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prelate')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('primas_germaniae')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('legatus_natus')] have limited power

name: Bicameral Imperial Diet
description:
The [ShowParliamentTypeName('hre_bi_camerial_imperial_diet')] expands representation by granting voting rights to ecclesiastical dignitaries and princely rulers alike, forming two chambers within the Diet.

$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Standard power for [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('emperor')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')], and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prince')]
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prelate')] gain meaningful influence
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')] and [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_peasant_republic')] still lack representation

name: Tricameral Imperial Diet
description:
With the [ShowParliamentTypeName('hre_tri_camerial_imperial_diet')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')] finally gain a decisive voice. The Imperial Diet now consists of three chambers — ecclesiastical, princely, and civic — reflecting a more inclusive balance of power.

$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Balanced power among [ShowSpecialStatusName('emperor')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('elector')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('archbishop_elector')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_prince')], [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('free_city')], and minor theocratic roles
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ [ShowSpecialStatusNamePlural('imperial_peasant_republic')] gain the highest influence here
$BULLET_WITH_TAB$ Most inclusive form of the Diet
